# 4 BHK Luxury New Builder Floor for Rent in Gurgaon

Experience premium living in this beautifully designed **4 BHK Brand New Luxury Builder Floor for Rent in Gurgaon**. Featuring spacious bedrooms, elegant interiors, modern architecture and high-quality fittings, this property offers the perfect combination of comfort, luxury and convenience.

The floor is thoughtfully designed with a spacious living and dining area, modular kitchen, well-ventilated bedrooms, attached modern bathrooms and balconies. Enjoy premium amenities, ample natural light and a peaceful residential environment.

**Key Features:**
- 4 Spacious Bedrooms with Attached Bathrooms
- Brand New Construction
- Modern Modular Kitchen
- Premium Interiors and High-Quality Fittings
- Spacious Living and Dining Area
- Lift and Dedicated Car Parking
- 24×7 Security
- Power Backup
- Peaceful and Family-Friendly Location
- Excellent Connectivity to Major Roads and Markets

**Ideal For:** Families, Corporate Professionals, and Expats.
